metadata.title: RAS-pathway ERK-phosphorylation suppression
metadata.note: Raw author and database records are retained. Author CSV structure extraction is not an independent redraw of all structures. Exposure uncertainty is disclosed and is not replaced with guessed timing.

M001.context: Human CAPAN-1 pancreatic cancer cells bearing KRAS G12V; 4 h compound exposure; ERK1/2 phosphorylation by AlphaLISA; author-reported geometric-mean qAC50.
M001.context_evidence: Author CSV explicitly identifies CAPAN1 pERK qAC50; ChEMBL CHEMBL6119125 for context. Preserve qAC50 terminology; biochemical and viability columns excluded.
